title: Toddler Sitting on Lawn, 1956 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white photograph featuring a toddler sitting on the grass in a garden setting in April 1956, as stamped on the right margin ('APR • 56'). The young child wears dark overalls with suspenders and small white shoes. Behind the child are lush garden plants, including rose bushes and tall gladiolus leaves, set against a light building facade. The photo features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-century home snapshots.
